memo: New component on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except the CPU edits; our best stack kept (fragment re-rank on blind molecules + neutral-loss evidence = e3fg05nl05c-1 0.434). New part (ours_tx): a test-set chemotype prior. Natural products come in families, so each molecule's final top 25 are re-ranked by z(-log rank) + 0.5 z(mean top-3 Morgan r2 Tanimoto to the OTHER test molecules' rank-1 structures). It is transductive structure evidence, not spectral evidence competing with GLACIER. Train check: on enveda-np-examples (171 molecules, truth among 49 same-formula train isomers, anchors = the other molecules' truths) the similarity alone gives MRR 0.533 vs random 0.289, and 0.465 with 60% of the anchors replaced by wrong isomers; on enveda-180 (no families) 0.207 vs 0.189. Hypothesis: the hidden natural-product test has families -> LB > 0.434, toward bronze 0.441.
